label: Every existent at w is CONCRETE_6, from contract and calibration (inference)
rule: Existence to act as to being, then esse in re to concreteness
meaning: Let x exist at w. By the existence-to-act contract x is in act as to being; by the CONCRETE_6 calibration what has esse in re is concrete; so x is concrete. No causal premise is used. Each premise is needed in a checked interpretation (controls 1 and 2). It refutes, conditionally on both open premises, the recorded rival that some actual concretum has an existing non-concrete cause of its esse: that rival's cause exists at w. This relocates the Platonist rival; it does not defeat it. Under CONCRETE_6 (having one's own act of existence in reality) a separately existing Form or mind-independent set is CONCRETE_6, so the rival 4c9908ba is not the Platonist's thesis. A Platonist or Lewisian must (i) deny the existence-to-act contract, (ii) read concrete other than as CONCRETE_6, or (iii) accept that the Form has esse in re and is CONCRETE_6; on (iii) the bridge counts the Form as an actual concrete ground, and the dispute moves to the downstream uniqueness, identity and simplicity steps. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
